author: MaximumGamerrrr
quote:
What a let down in one of the greatest franchises gaming has given us. E
The main characters are insufferable. Story is absurdly mediocre and the freedom these games have given us have been taken away. 

Besides that the amount of bugs and missing visuals for certain actions for a game that has been THIRTEEN years in development.

If you haven't bought this... for the love of God don't... don't support these developers. I have requested a refund as they are required to do so by law in our country. ASHAME
